_readiness: This is an Ark Constellation DEVNET deployment. It has not been audited and
must not be treated as production. See docs/PRODUCTION-READINESS.md for the
gates that remain open (llm.txt s53, s57).
feeToSetter is a single deployer EOA, which is acceptable for devnet only
(llm.txt s25). Any long-lived deployment must use an Ark team multisig.

compiler.note: These settings determine ArkSwapPair creation code and therefore pairInitCodeHash. Changing any of them requires `make init-code-hash` and a fresh review.

verified.pairsNote: Blockscout cannot verify the pairs: the Ark devnet node exposes no trace API (debug_traceTransaction / trace_transaction / debug_traceBlockByNumber / trace_block all return 'does not exist/is not available'), so Blockscout's internal-transaction fetcher never sees the factory's CREATE2 call, records no creation, and rejects verification server-side with 'The address is not a smart contract'. Not a contract defect. Attested by bytecode instead: all three pairs carry runtime code byte-identical to the compiled ArkSwapPair, keccak256 0x2ecfe3b325ceceff28477c0c7f82692713e4c2e8d08a11d1ffc535c19af1d75f. Reproduce with `make verify-pairs-local`; run `make verify-pairs` once node tracing is enabled.
